senses.gloss:
1. युत्, त्, त्, त् (for rt. 2. युत् see s.v.), keeping off,
preventing.

युत् 2. युत् (allied to rts. जुत्, ज्युत्, द्युत्;
for 1. युत् see p. 817, col. 2), cl. 1. A.
योतते, &c., to shine; [cf. Hib. iudh, ‘a day;’
an-iudh, ‘to-day;’ iodhna, ‘brightness, purity;’
‘clean, pure.’]

1. युत, अस्, आ, अम् (for 2. see col. 3), separated,
separate.
—युत-द्वेषस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. delivered
from enemies, relieved from foes, (Sāy. = पृथग्-
भूत-शत्रुक.)

2. युत, अस्, आ, अम् (often at the end of comps.),
fastened to or on, attached to [cf. वडिश-य्˚]; added,
joined, united; connected or joined with, accom-
panied, attended by, furnished with, endowed with,
possessed of, filled with, covered with; (अम्), n. a
particular measure of length = 4 Hastas.

युत युत, युतक. See under rts. 1. and 2.
यु, p. 817.

युतक, अस्, आ, अम्, attached, connected, joined,
united; (अम्), n. a pair, couple; union, alliance,
friendship, forming friendship; a nuptial gift or
present (= यौतक); a sort of cloth or dress; a sort
of dress worn by women; the edge of a garment,
border of a woman's dress; the edge of a winnow-
ing basket; suspicion, doubt, uncertainty (= सं-
शय); an asylum, refuge (= सं-श्रय).

युति, इस्, f. uniting, joining, junction, union; the
being furnished with (with inst.); the obtaining pos-
session of; the sum, total number; (in arithmetic)
addition; (in astronomy) conjunction.

यूति यूति, इस्, f. (fr. rt. 2. यु), joining,
mixing, mixture, junction, connection, union, addi-
tion; [cf. युति, वहिर्-यूति.]

युत्कार युत्-कार, युद्-भू. See under 2.
युध्, col. 3.
